name: tilttek/table-safety
description: Table safety tools for tabletop and live-action role-playing games: lines and veils on the themes of phil/content-warnings, a green, yellow and red consent checklist with the anonymous agreement of a table, session zero with its built-in templates and its pact, the X-card, Script Change and the open door as anonymous signals seen by the table or by the game master alone, check-ins, stars and wishes, and the export and erasure of a participant
